صُوَاحٌ Gypsum. (S, K.) ―
-b2- And (assumed tropical:) The sweat of horses: (S, K:) said to be likened to gypsum because of its whiteness. (T, L.) ―
-b3- And (assumed tropical:) Milk mixed with water, the latter being the more in quantity. (Aboo-Sa'eed, K.) ―
-b4- Also An elevated piece, (نَجْوَة, so in the L and CK, and in my MS. copy of the K,) or such as is soft, or yielding, (رِخْوَة, so in the TA as from the K,) of land. (L, K.) ―
-b5- And The spadix (طَلْع) of the palm-tree, (AHn, K,) when it dries up, and falls in pieces and becomes scattered. (AHn.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
